news.title: Ryanair brutally mocks Argentina after World Cup winner Rodri spotted on ultra-low-budget flight
news.lede: Ryanair has joined the growing social-media frenzy around Rodri's unlikely journey home, turning the Manchester City midfielder's viral economy-flight appearance into an opportunity for some football banter. After the Spain international was photographed boarding one of its flights from Madrid to Liverpool, the airline aimed its latest joke at Argentina with a pointed message about who qualifies as a “winner”. Football News: Ryanair joins the football banter after Rodri, the World Cup-winning midfielder, is spotted on a budget flight, provoking a cheeky response aimed at Argentina.

news.title: Europe’s top clubs threatened Club World Cup boycott before Fifa plan collapsed
news.lede: Ultimatum issued hours before plan was scrapped. European Football Clubs demanded Infantino back down. Europe’s leading clubs threatened not to participate in future Club World Cups unless Gianni Infantino withdrew his Fifa Forward Enterprise scheme, issuing their ultimatum hours before the plan was scrapped. In a letter to the Fifa secretary general, Mattias Grafström, the influential European Football Clubs (EFC) group warned that its cooperation with future tournaments would hinge on Infantino backing down.

news.title: Africa’s Representatives Take Shape for 2027 Women’s World Cup in Brazil
news.lede: Rabat - Africa’s lineup for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup is taking shape, with four nations securing direct qualification for the tournament in Brazil. Morocco, Malawi, Cameroon, and Algeria earned their places after reaching the semifinals of the 2026 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON). While Morocco is hosting the continental tournament, its place at the 2027 World Cup was not automatic. The Atlas Lionesses secured qualification on the pitch by defeating defending champions South Africa 2–1 in the quarterfinals.

news.title: Watch: World Cup Golden Ball winner Rodri shocks passengers by boarding ultra-budget Ryanair flight to Li
news.lede: Rodri has spent the past year at the very top of world football, but the Manchester City midfielder offered a rather different image of himself while making his way back to England. The 30-year-old Spain international was spotted queuing for a budget Ryanair flight from Madrid to Liverpool, leaving fellow passengers stunned as they realised who was standing among them. Football News: World Cup Golden Ball winner Rodri surprises fans by opting for a budget Ryanair flight home to Liverpool, showcasing his down-to-earth persona despite football stardom.

news.title: Soccer-FIFA crisis timeline: From World Cup final to global standoff
news.lede: Aug 14 (Reuters) – Here is a timeline of events where FIFA president Gianni Infantino introduced a proposal to sell a slice of the World Cup’s commercial future that backfired and sparked a global revolt in the sport:. July 19 – The first 48-team World Cup concludes at New York New Jersey stadium with Infantino and U.S. President Donald Trump, booed as they walked onto the pitch, presenting the trophy to Spain after their 1-0 win over Argentina. July 28 – Shortly after a leak in the British media, FIFA announces it wants to create a $20 billion subsidiary to run the World Cup and other competitions, raising $4.2 billion for soccer development by selling a 20% stake to external investors.

news.title: Oceania declares support for Infantino in boost for Fifa president but New Zealand breaks ranks
news.lede: OFC’s 11 votes could prove crucial in Fifa election. Stance shows continued backing from smaller nations. The Oceania Football Confederation (OFC) has declared its support for Gianni Infantino following demands from Uefa, Concacaf and the Asian Football Confederation for the Fifa president to resign, in a development that further highlights world football’s civil war. After a meeting of its executive committee in Fiji on Wednesday, the OFC issued a statement on Friday praising “the progress achieved over the last decade” by Fifa in its first public comments since the abandoned World Cup sell-off plan emerged this month.

news.title: NFF Probes Nigeria’s Football Setbacks After Super Falcons’ World Cup Failure
news.lede: NFF sets up committee to investigate national teams’ poor international run after Falcons miss 2027 World Cup qualification. The Nigeria Football Federation has set up a fact-finding committee to investigate the poor performance of the country’s national teams in international competitions. The move follows the Super Falcons’ failure to qualify for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup, according to a statement by the NFF Communications Department. The federation said the committee would examine the “unwholesome poor run” of Nigeria’s national teams, with particular attention to the Super Falcons’ failure to secure a place at next year’s World Cup.

news.title: NFF launches probe into Nigeria’s football decline after World Cup failure
news.lede: The Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) has constituted a fact-finding committee to investigate the country’s recent poor performances in international football following the Super Falcons’ failure to qualify for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup. The move comes after the Super Falcons, 10-time African champions and holders of the Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON), suffered a disappointing exit from the 2026 tournament in Morocco.
